regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 4 reaction drawing, entries 1--10, and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten separate substrate-scope experiments were retained with aldehyde/allene identities, NMR and isolated yields, dr before/after separation, major/minor isolated yields for 5ca and 5ee, and entry-10 byproduct yields. Entry 10 has separate -10 °C/32 h and warming-to-50 °C/14.5 h stages.

One unsuccessful target-forming experiment was retained: expected cyclopentenol is not formed, 6fa is observed at 6%, and aldehyde 1f/allene 2a recoveries are 58%/39% under A1/Cs2CO3 at -10 °C for 22 h.

Four distinct mechanistic controls were retained. Three show non-formation of 5ba with 93%, 81%, or 95% substrate recovery; the Z-3ba/A1/Cs2CO3 control gives 5ba 34% NMR, 4ba 3% NMR, dr 97:3, and 41% recovery.
The 1b-D/2a experiment was retained with >99% D starting aldehyde, -10 °C/22 h, 71% 5ba-D, dr 99:1, and four position-specific D incorporations (19%, 34%, 12%, 16%).
The Int-A--Int-H routes are mechanistic proposals linked to Scheme 4 on page 5, not isolated experiments.
